atoms.b: To convert from a larger unit to a smaller one, measurements need to be ((++multiplied divided)) by 10, 100 or 1,000.
To multiply a decimal by 10, each digit has to move one place to the ((++left right)).
To multiply a decimal by 100, each digit has to move ((one ++two three)) places to the left.
To multiply a decimal by 1,000, each digit has to move ((one two ++three)) places to the left.

instruction.text: How many millimetres are 817.3 centimetres? Drag the digits to the correct places.
instruction.sound: How many millimetres are 817.3 cm? Drag the digits to the correct places.

hint.text: To convert a measurement from centimetres to millimetres, the number of centimetres needs to be multiplied by ten. To multiply a number by ten, each digit needs to move one place to the left.

end.text: Well done. 817.3 cm is the same length as <mat>8173</mat> mm.
end.sound: Well done. 817.3 cm is the same length as 8173 mm.

instruction.text: How many centimetres are 90.62 metres? Drag the digits to the correct places.
instruction.sound: How many centimetres are 90.62 metres? Drag the digits to the correct places.

hint.text: To convert a measurement from metres to centimetres, the number of metres needs to be multiplied by one hundred. To multiply a number by one hundred, each digit needs to move two places to the left.

end.text: Good job. 90.62 m is the same length as <mat>9062</mat> cm.
end.sound: Good job. 90.62 metres is the same length as 9062 cm.

instruction.text: How many metres are 4.97 kilometres? Drag the digits to the correct places.
instruction.sound: How many metres are 4.97 km? Drag the digits to the correct places.

hint.text: To convert a measurement from kilometres to metres, the number of kilometres needs to be multiplied by one thousand. To multiply a number by one thousand, each digit needs to move three places to the left.

end.text: Exactly. 4.97 km is the same length as <mat>4970</mat> m.
end.sound: Exactly. 4.97 km is the same length as 4970 metres.
